title: Alvotech announces successful closure of FDA inspection of manufacturing facility

title: Curium advances plans for second investment in Romania to expand access to advanced nuclear medicine
llm_note: Curium is planning to invest in a second cyclotron facility in Romania to expand nuclear medicine production.

title: Celonic and Leukocare Collaborate to Support Complex Biologics and Advanced Drug Development

title: Biopharma Hungry for GLP-1 Receptor Agonist Manufacturing Skills
llm_note: NIBRT is launching a new training course specifically to address the manufacturing workforce shortage for GLP-1 agonists.

title: Capsid Experts Hope to Slash the Cost of Gene Therapies
